records.title: Ripple 2026 Swell strategy, OCC charter, Prime, Treasury, payments and XRPL partnerships
records.note: Ripple reports a $900M annualized product revenue run rate target by year-end, $16T transactions enabled across products in 2025, 85+ licenses, 1,700+ institutions, 60+ payout markets and approaching $150B lifetime Ripple Payments volume. It describes RNTB reserve-management/collateral-trustee roles upon opening, RLUSD distribution, Ripple Prime event contracts/RWA perpetuals, Ripple Treasury 24/7 Returns, BNY/C2FO XRPL trade-finance initiative, and Privy (Stripe) programmable wallets supporting XRP/RLUSD. All metrics are company-reported; product volume is not XRP settlement volume or recognized revenue.

records.title: OCC Corporate Decision 1370: Coinbase National Trust Company
records.note: OCC decision grants preliminary conditional approval, not final effective charter status. Proposed national trust bank scope is institutional custody; it does not issue stablecoins and would facilitate access to affiliated Prime Trading/Financing products without providing those services itself. No final approval/effective status verified as of this audit.

records.title: Osaka Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd. (SBIC West Japan) company profile
records.note: Official profile identifies Osaka Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd. (SBIC West Japan), established 1963, a policy investment/growth-support institution under Japan's SME Investment & Development Companies Act, with 24-prefecture western territory and sister companies Tokyo and Nagoya. The three regional companies cover Japan. It is distinct from SBI Holdings; no XRP relationship is disclosed.

records.title: SBIC West Japan Investment Forum 128: generative AI/ChatGPT seminar, 2024-10-23
records.note: Official SBIC West Japan PDF advertises a 2024-10-23 generative-AI introductory seminar for accounting firms and support organizations, explicitly mentioning ChatGPT. This is an educational event, not evidence of an OpenAI partnership, XRP investment, or SBI Holdings affiliation.

records.title: ACI Worldwide and Circle collaborate on USDC settlement in Latin America
records.note: Circle/ACI announce a Colombian pilot using ACI Connetic and the Bre-B instant-payments infrastructure to evaluate USDC settlement alongside existing payment rails. This is a pilot/implementation announcement, not evidence of completed settlement volume or direct XRP use.
